session.authenticate: Opens the session. A signed-in call cannot send it; the gateway answers already_authenticated.
attachment.write: One piece of an upload's bytes for a surface that cannot reach PUT /attachments. The action is attachment.begin; the bytes are not a JSON call.
grants.subscribe: Follows this receiver's grants by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
grants.page: Continues one grant snapshot on the subscription that opened it. One call would drop the stream.
grants.unsubscribe: Stops the grant subscription on this connection. It names a subscription the stream minted.
conversation.subscribe: Follows one conversation by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
conversation.subscribeList: Follows the conversation list by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
conversation.subscribeEvents: Follows one conversation's events by a stream after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
agents.subscribe: Follows the agent catalog by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
workspace.answer: A window's answer to a workspace.command the gateway sent it on that same connection. Only the window that was asked can give it.
terminal.open: A person's terminal: only the window showing it opens, reads or types into it. No agent, CLI or MCP call does.
terminal.list: A person's terminal: only the window showing it opens, reads or types into it. No agent, CLI or MCP call does.

terminal.detach: A person's terminal: only the window showing it opens, reads or types into it. No agent, CLI or MCP call does.

terminal.resumeSettings: Which terminal programs come back after a restart, and which kept ones are forgotten, is the person's own choice in Settings. No agent, CLI or MCP call reads or changes it.
terminal.setResumeSettings: Which terminal programs come back after a restart, and which kept ones are forgotten, is the person's own choice in Settings. No agent, CLI or MCP call reads or changes it.
terminal.forgetSaved: Which terminal programs come back after a restart, and which kept ones are forgotten, is the person's own choice in Settings. No agent, CLI or MCP call reads or changes it.
apps.install: Installing or removing an app is the owner's own choice, made in Nessa's Settings behind a native confirmation that shows the reviewed package. No agent, CLI or MCP call installs or removes one.
apps.uninstall: Installing or removing an app is the owner's own choice, made in Nessa's Settings behind a native confirmation that shows the reviewed package. No agent, CLI or MCP call installs or removes one.
apps.issueCredential: An app's credential is a secret handed to that app's own launcher by Nessa's Settings. No agent, CLI or MCP call is answered one.
apps.revokeCredentials: Revoking an app's credentials is the owner's choice in Nessa's Settings, and uninstalling does it. No agent, CLI or MCP call revokes them.
